note_company: Playtika (mobile/social gaming conglomerate; owns Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, Caesars Games, House of Fun, WSOP, Wooga, Seriously/Best Fiends, Redecor, Board Kings, Monopoly Poker)
critical_constraints: MUST send header 'X-Bug-Bounty: True' on all requests.
No scanners that generate significant traffic volume.
DoS out of scope; keep rate limits gentle.
policy_notes: Public program, no confidentiality clause -> memory/ ok.
Takeover not explicitly excluded -> eligible WITH proof (CNAME-verify always).
Acquired multi-brand gaming infra = high odds of dangling DNS / forgotten assets (Superbet-shaped).

Out of scope: 3rd-party product bugs, brute force/rate-limit w/o vector, user enum w/o PII, clickjacking no-sensitive, CSRF unauth, MITM, known-vuln-libs w/o PoC, CSV injection w/o vuln, SSL/TLS best-practice/HSTS, DoS, content spoofing, missing headers/cookie flags w/o PoC, mobile insecure storage / deep-link crash / missing SSL-pinning w/o PoC, SPF/DKIM/DMARC.
